title: scrumia-design — ScrumIA
meta_description: scrumia-design: the ScrumIA design slot — identity, tokens and components in the repo, plus the designer role.
tagline: Identity, tokens and components in the repo — and the role that guards them.
responsibilities: Owns what a user actually sees: the written identity, the token vocabulary, one directory per component, an audit that reports drift and mutedness on equal footing, and a sync that publishes a component to a Claude Design project one at a time. Ships the designer standing role — the only role contributed from outside the team slot.
refusals: A value the tokens do not carry is a finding, never an inlined exception. The remote project is a review surface, never the source of truth, and a wholesale replace is refused.
philosophy: Assumes the design system belongs in the repo, where it is versioned alongside what consumes it. Costs discipline on every single value — and a role with no design system to guard would only be judging on taste.
